name: runtime-system-capability-evaluation
purpose: Measure whether a model deployment can serve the same model workload reliably and efficiently; this is separate from model domain expertise.

protocol.model_artifact: Record immutable model path, revision, tokenizer, dtype, quantization, serving engine and engine version.
protocol.hardware: Record GPU model/count/VRAM, driver, CUDA runtime, topology, CPU, RAM, storage, and network.
protocol.workloads: Use fixed prompt and generation distributions for short, medium, long-context, mixed, concurrent, tool-call, and failure-recovery scenarios.
protocol.warmup: Exclude a declared warmup phase; report cold-start separately.
protocol.repetitions: Use at least 30 requests per scenario for latency distributions and repeat each scenario at least 3 times.
protocol.isolation: Stop training jobs and unrelated GPU processes; record the exact process and environment state.

scenarios.load: fixed tool schemas and mock observations

scenarios.description: Worker restart, timeout, malformed request and overload

reporting_rule: Never use runtime metrics as evidence that the model learned more domain knowledge. Report runtime results in a separate table.

recommended_slos.p99_latency: declare per workload; never compare without the same SLO
